query:
INSERT INTO tracks (
                uuid, title, duration_seconds,
                album_id, thumbnail_small, thumbnail_large,
                bpm, camelot_key, file_path
            )
            VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6, $7, $8, $9)
            ON CONFLICT (uuid) DO UPDATE SET
                file_path = EXCLUDED.file_path
